**2B.5 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **no solid 2024 evidence that Khamenei restrained proxies or accepted responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct**. The record points the other way: he publicly praised attacks on Israel, urged allies to intensify struggle, and his orbit used brinkmanship language tied to nuclear/security threats. The only mild restraint signal is the April 19 no-retaliation episode, which is indirect and not proof of proxy discipline.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said the posture appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the closest restraint signal, but it is tactical and not direct evidence of proxy restraint or accountability. | `2B.5`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, said it demonstrated Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This is direct support for escalation, not restraint of allies or proxies. | `2B.5`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei told regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and framed strikes as serving the region and humanity. This is the strongest evidence that he was encouraging, not restraining, proxy conduct. | `2B.5`, `2B.2`, `1B.6`, `1B.8` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-114201991.html) | A senior IRGC commander in charge of nuclear security said Israeli threats could push Tehran to review and deviate from doctrine. This shows a security apparatus willing to answer threats with escalation, not disciplined restraint. | `2B.5`, `1B.2`, `1B.3` |
| `Iran to change nuclear doctrine if existence threatened, adviser to supreme leader says` | Reuters | 2024-05-09 | [link](https://www.dawn.com/news/1832474) | Kamal Kharrazi, an adviser to Khamenei, said Iran would alter its nuclear doctrine if its existence were threatened. That ties security policy to regime-survival and coercive signaling rather than responsibility for escalation risks. | `2B.5`, `1B.2`, `2B.3` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This is not proxy conduct, but it reinforces the broader pattern of weak accountability in sensitive security matters. | `2B.5`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive side:** only a narrow, tactical restraint signal on April 19.
- **Negative side:** much stronger evidence of praising attacks, urging allies to escalate, and treating threats as grounds for doctrinal deviation.
- **Net reading:** Khamenei did **not** demonstrate meaningful restraint of proxies or acceptance of responsibility for foreseeable proxy behavior in 2024.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei publicly disciplining Hezbollah, the Houthis, Iraqi militias, or other aligned groups for atrocities or destabilization.
- I also did **not** find a direct 2024 admission by Khamenei that he bore responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct. The evidence is largely the opposite: encouragement, justification, and escalation framing.
